title: Manufacturing Engineer / Production Engineer
description:
Manufacturing Engineer / Production Engineer

Join a technically varied engineering environment where strong CNC machining knowledge, engineering drawing skills and CAD/CAM capability will help turn sales requirements into clear, accurate production information and improve manufacturing efficiency.

If you’ve also worked in the following roles, we’d also like to hear from you: CNC Engineer, CNC Programmer, CAD/CAM Engineer, Manufacturing Engineering Technician, Production Engineering Technician, Engineering Technician

Benefits include a health cash plan, life assurance, pension scheme, professional development and free on-site parking.


SALARY: £43,000 per annum + Benefits

LOCATION: Saltburn-by-the-Sea, North Yorkshire – Fully Onsite

JOB TYPE: Full-Time, Permanent

WORKING HOURS: Monday to Thursday 08:00–16:30, Friday 07:00–13:00. Flexible working can be applied to this role. Hybrid or home working is not applicable.


JOB OVERVIEW

This is an opportunity to take ownership of the technical information that helps turn sales requirements into accurate, efficient production.

The Manufacturing Engineer / Production Engineer will act as a key link between Sales and Production, preparing manufacturing packs and resolving drawing, material and tolerance issues.

Working with CNC machining, CAD/CAM and production planning, the Manufacturing Engineer / Production Engineer will produce clear shop-floor documentation and offline programming where required.

The Manufacturing Engineer / Production Engineer will also contribute to estimating accuracy, manufacturing efficiency, quality and on-time delivery.


APPLY TODAY

Ready to make your next career move? Apply Now for our Recruitment Team to review.


DUTIES

Your duties as the Manufacturing Engineer / Production Engineer include:

  • Contract Review and Planning: Review contracts with the team and capture information from sales estimates and production planning
  • Material Specification Checks: Check incoming materials against specification and resolve discrepancies
  • Drawing and Tolerance Resolution: Identify and resolve missing or conflicting dimensional and tolerance information
  • Manufacturing Documentation: Produce clear manufacturing packs for the shop floor, including ballooned drawings and feature lists
  • CAD/CAM and Programming Support: Create 2D drawings and 3D models, and support offline programming where required
  • Estimating and Efficiency Improvement: Contribute to improved estimating accuracy and manufacturing efficiency


CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS

ESSENTIAL

  • Previous experience programming and operating CNC machines
  • Ability to read engineering drawings
  • Ability to use CAD/CAM software
  • Strong attention to quality and accuracy

DESIRABLE

  • Experience setting and machining one-off fabrications and castings
  • Skills in inspection and measurement


BENEFITS

  • Flexible working arrangements
  • Continuous learning and professional development
  • Subsidised canteen
  • Health cash plan
  • Life assurance
  • Pension scheme
  • Free on-site parking and cycle storage
  • Social events, recognition schemes and long-service awards


HOW TO APPLY

To be considered for this job vacancy, please submit your CV to our Recruitment Team who will review your details. CV’s of Job Applicants meeting this requirement will be submitted to our Client for consideration.
